info.title: Snowball local middleware API
info.description: Loopback local control. Normal runtime has no login/PIN. Exact Host and same-origin mutation checks apply in both modes; no CORS or external listener. Optional token mode is explicitly selected by the operator. Queue admission is not an execution receipt; a composed runtime dispatches admitted commands through SessionService.

port.description: Use the actual port returned by the local runtime.

post.description: Consume a one-use grant minted by the trusted tray/CLI, valid for 60 seconds. No public grant-minting route.

201.description: Memory-only credentials. Do not log/store in URLs or browser storage.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact listener origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43123. No remote, null, or alias origin.

get.description: Atomic current host summary and cursor. Omits command payloads and decision answer details.

post.description: Admit to the durable queue. actorId comes from authentication. Identical ID+intent returns original. This route does not dispatch. No automatic retries.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact listener origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43123. No remote, null, or alias origin.

get.description: Exact owner/native request, current local revision and canonical allowed answers.
Authenticated fetch SSE. changed invalidates cached state. resync requires GET snapshot then reconnect from its cursor. Events are volatile across restart; no query credentials.

200.description: Bounded changed/resync events. Data is JSON containing cursor; resync also contains snapshot: /v1/snapshot.

get.description: Read at most 256 KiB of UTF-8 text beneath a trusted registered workspace. Rejects symlinks/traversal/ADS. No remote registration or arbitrary absolute paths.

post.description: Revoke current controller session and close its streams.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact listener origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43123. No remote, null, or alias origin.

post.description: Rerun bounded harness candidate metadata collection on explicit user action. Returns the reviewed survey; never probes, installs, starts, logs in or sends commands. One scan at a time; a hung surveyor retains its slot until settlement.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact listener origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43123. No remote, null, or alias origin.

200.description: Reviewed candidate survey. Empty is valid; unprobed candidates never imply control.

post.description: Open native Codex CLI executable, existing home and working-directory pickers; verify version and SHA-256; ask the user to review the exact launch. The browser supplies no path, account or command. A successful connection registers a new explicit instance; existing sessions remain read-only until attached.

200.description: Native reviewed instance connected and private selection saved.

post.description: After native confirmation, remove one saved middleware-owned Codex instance. Its observed tasks remain read-only and unknown commands are never replayed.

200.description: Saved instance removed after native confirmation.

post.description: Native-confirmed repair of all saved Codex connection references. Does not delete the provider login home or middleware task history.

200.description: Saved Codex references cleared after native confirmation.

post.description: Reinspect an already registered local root. Never registers, relocates or grants a candidate path. No network discovery. Four concurrent checks maximum, one per workspace; failed/hung filesystem operations retain their occupied slot until settlement. HTTP wait is bounded to 3 seconds (504); native work retains its slot until settlement.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Exact listener origin, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:43123. No remote, null, or alias origin.

200.description: Observed workspace state; empty is valid, missing may mean moved or deleted.

post.description: Ask the trusted native picker to choose a directory. Empty body only: the browser cannot supply a root. Auth/CSRF and authorization before durable commit; one selection at a time, cancel on disconnect/revocation, 120-second budget. Cancelled or late native results do not register. Store fsync precedes successful response.

parameters.name: Origin

200.description: Selected and durably registered, or native dialog cancelled.

post.description: Uses an explicitly connected local harness. Discovery never launches it.

post.description: Creates a real session using a registered workspace and durable client request ID. The same ID never launches native creation twice. An unconfirmed result requires explicit native-session inspection; no automatic replay.

requestId.description: Stable ID for this user creation attempt; retain across timeout and restart

200.description: Native session key, current owner (nullable on read-only recovery), restoredReadOnly and updated snapshot

409.description: Paused, mismatched instance, duplicate uncertain request or request-ID input mismatch

503.description: Provider unavailable or creation result unconfirmed; inspect session list before retry

post.description: Read a durable creation receipt by request ID. Unconfirmed means native creation may or may not have occurred; inspect the native session list and attach an exact selected session manually.

200.description: confirmed with sessionKey, or unconfirmed without one

patch.description: Revision-checked settings; native autostart must apply before success. No mutation is automatically retried.

409.description: Stale revision, busy settings or unavailable native autostart

503.description: Native or persistence side effect failed

payload.description: Plain JSON, at most 64 KiB canonical encoding, nesting at most 32.
Plain JSON, at most 64 KiB canonical encoding, nesting at most 32.

harness.description: Reviewed harness candidate survey, or null when the runtime supplies no surveyor. Never control evidence.

sessionMessages.description: Bounded live projection: at most 64 sessions; not full native history.

workspaceId.description: Exact registered-root association when one exists; discovery alone grants no workspace access.

realSessions.description: Legacy observation-only projection; never ownership evidence.

turnsStore.description: Legacy transcript projection; production runtime uses bounded sessionMessages.

language.description: Native tray menu and notification language; Web UI is currently Korean.

notifications.description: Native tray OS alerts for newly pending decisions or uncertain/failed commands; no task content in OS notifications.

workspaceId.description: Registered local workspace selected when this session was created, when known

Error.description: Generic error code; no raw exception/path/credential. Authentication 401, origin/CSRF 403, stale intent 409, capacity 429, unavailable 503.
